description: Na₄MgMn₂O₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with three MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and edges with three MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.76 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with four MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and edges with two MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.62 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.82 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with seven NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with three NaO₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.39 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with two NaO₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.10 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Mn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Mn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two Mn atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Mn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Mn₂ octahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and two Mn atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Mn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Mn₂ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 30°.
